stage0026_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No way!
　They've come even to this city!?」

stage0026_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
???
「Smells nice...
　so this is Vega, huh...」

stage0026_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
???
「And there's one who smells the strongest of all...!」

stage0026_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's okay, $$ミコノ$$!
　Aquarion's here!」

stage0026_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Why do we have to team up with the boys...!」

stage0026_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Can't be helped, $$ＭＩＸ$$.
　There's just too many Abductors this time」

stage0026_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Never thought they'd show up so close to the academy」

stage0026_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Saves us the trouble of sortieing far out.
　Let's wrap this up quick」

stage0026_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Don't get careless, $$カイエン$$, $$アンディ$$」

stage0026_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Looks like the boys are fired up」

stage0026_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Even on a joint boy-girl sortie,
　it's still boys with boys, girls with girls...」

stage0026_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$サザンカ$$!
　There's no way we'd combine with filthy boys!」

stage0026_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'd like to try combining with a boy.
　Combining with girls feels this good already,
　so I bet it'd be even more thrilling」

stage0026_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Uh oh, Miss $$スオミ$$ heard that」

stage0026_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スオミ$$
「The Maidens of the Sky have their purity
　protected by the Guize Stone!
　Combining male and female units is unthinkable!」

stage0026_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Aquarion is a sacred cradle,
　and a fallen maiden who knows the taint
　of the opposite sex isn't allowed aboard!」

stage0026_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Who cares...!
　We'll drive them off ourselves!」

stage0026_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「That's right, $$カイエン$$.
　Show them what your training's worth!」

stage0026_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$スオミ$$
「I'd think that many enemies is too much
　for boys who lack delicate judgment」

stage0026_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Judgment?
　Girls are far shakier on that front!」

stage0026_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$学園長$$
「Enough, both of you.
　This time, a type of enemy we've
　never seen before has shown up too」

stage0026_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$...!
　Let's get to safety, quick!」

stage0026_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アマタ$$... don't you hear something...?」

stage0026_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This... is it some kind of voice...?」

stage0026_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$スオミ$$
「The dimensional boundary is warping!
　Far exceeding the standard level!」

stage0026_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ドナール$$
「This isn't like when Abductors appear!
　It's a $$時空震動$$!」

stage0026_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（12,000 years ago... 24,000 years ago...
　No, since 120,000,000 years ago...）

stage0026_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アマタ$$
「C, could that have been
　the $$時空震動$$ from before...!?」

stage0026_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「If that's true... then this place is...」

stage0026_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Checking surrounding terrain data!
　Looks like a 10 km radius around the academy
　has been transferred!」

stage0026_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Our current spot seems to be what we'd
　call Tokyo, on our Earth!」

stage0026_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$学園長$$
「What is this...!
　To think $$聖天使学園$$ itself
　got caught in a $$時空震動$$!」

stage0026_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Aquarion M-type and F-type both intact!
　And just as before the transfer,
　Abductors are here too!」

stage0026_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... came to scout Vega,
　and got a $$時空震動$$ instead.
　Pretty thrilling」

stage0026_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カグラ$$
「But wherever this is,
　I'm gonna raise some hell!」

stage0026_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa!
　You're gonna fight even in a mess like this!?」

stage0026_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$モロイ$$
「That thing's not like
　any Abductor we've fought before...!」

stage0026_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Its speed and power are on another level!」

stage0026_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「No way! Even $$カイエン$$ can't win!?」

stage0026_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$サザンカ$$!
　This isn't the time for that!」

stage0026_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$ is right!
　That thing... it's no ordinary Abductor!」

stage0026_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... is that all you got」

stage0026_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アンディ$$
「For real!?
　Then if we catch that guy,
　we'll learn what Abductors really are!」

stage0026_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Oh no!
　Other Abductors are attacking the city!」

stage0026_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Those things...!
　Kidnapping women even now!?」

stage0026_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Can you hear me, girls!
　We'll pincer him and take him down!」

stage0026_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アンディ$$
「This is no time for that!」

stage0026_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ドナール$$
「But this is a dangerous gamble.
　If a boy and girl combined, even by
　the slightest chance...!」

stage0026_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$学園長$$
「However much they long for each other,
　theirs is a fate that can't be joined!
　The Guize Stone's wall of purity forbids it!」

stage0026_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シン$$
「So this whole area got flung here
　by a $$時空震動$$!?」

stage0026_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Those spider-like robots over there
　seem to be fighting that blue and pink
　robot...」

stage0026_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「The spider guys gotta be the bad ones!
　They're attacking women!」

stage0026_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, what should we do?」

stage0026_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Hmm, hrm... this case wasn't expected...
　We came to investigate a transfer,
　and now we run into a battle...」

stage0026_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, attack the spider-type robots
　attacking the people」

stage0026_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Is that all right, Captain $$ジェフリー$$!?」

stage0026_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I can't judge right from wrong here,
　but we can't overlook this situation」

stage0026_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I agree with Captain $$ジェフリー$$ as well.
　If we abandon civilians here instead, it'll breed
　distrust when we later make official contact」

stage0026_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Now that's more like it!
　We'll head out for the rescue!」

stage0026_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Stay sharp!
　That one humanoid... looks like real trouble!」

stage0026_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$葵$$
「Yeah.
　Weird thing for me to say, but it's
　just like a wild beast」

stage0026_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Lucky! Looks like they're helping us!」

stage0026_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カイエン$$
「But don't let your guard down.
　They're not confirmed allies yet」

stage0026_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't look away when I'm right in front of you!!」

stage0026_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Aquarion M-type and F-type!
　Both broke combination and separated!
　Withdrawing from the battle zone!」

stage0026_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Honestly!
　What are those two doing!?」

stage0026_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Their first joint sortie with the boys,
　and a $$時空震動$$ on top of it...
　seems all these firsts rattled them」

stage0026_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$学園長$$
「At this point, we have no choice
　but to entrust our fate to this
　world's military...!」

stage0026_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... this Aquarion thing
　wasn't all it was rumored to be」

stage0026_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Watch out!
　It's coming this way!」

stage0026_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Not nearly enough of a meal!
　Next I'll play with you lot!」

stage0026_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This isn't good, is it」

stage0026_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$田中司令$$
「More and more guests keep coming to this area」

stage0026_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$リディ$$
「A man and a woman are fused together, half and half!」

stage0026_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「His name's $$あしゅら男爵$$.
　Used to be Dr. Hell's underling,
　but now he's the Mechanical Beast Legion's boss」

stage0026_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$タケル$$
「And that guy's also $$甲児$$'s arch-enemy」

stage0026_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$あしゅら$$!
　Still robbing the wreckage as always!」

stage0026_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Kukuku... Don't be so cold, $$兜甲児$$.
　I only came here to confirm something.」

stage0026_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「That's right...
　The omen of the world's end, the being past all myth.」

stage0026_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「And it seems
　I'm not the only one who wants to know.」

stage0026_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You jerk!
　Showing up at a time like this!」

stage0026_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Answer me, $$あしゅら$$!
　What do you mean, the world's last day!?」

stage0026_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Do you have time to be asking such things?」

stage0026_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カレン$$
「Late to the party,
　and already causing this much chaos!」

stage0026_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't know who the hell you are,
　but you sure liven things up!」

stage0026_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This is bad!
　We need to stop it first!」

stage0026_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シン$$
「A person... a man and a woman are flying!?」

stage0026_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「With only the Vectors that could still move,
　I came to fight again, but...」

stage0026_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What are you doing, $$アンディ$$!
　Don't go running off on your own!」

stage0026_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm right here!
　The Vector spat me out on its own!」

stage0026_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then that Vector Zed... it's unmanned!?」

stage0026_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Did that man and woman get into the Vector!?」

stage0026_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ドナール$$
「They hijacked a Vector!?
　Who the hell are they!」

stage0026_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$スオミ$$
「We can't force-eject the intruders!
　Their bio-energy is fully synced with the Vector!」

stage0026_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$学園長$$
「Could it be Aquaria... that called those two here!?」

stage0026_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Really, why is that...
　But I feel like I understand.」

stage0026_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Right now, here, there's something I must do...!」

stage0026_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I don't know!
　The Vector's being pulled on its own!」

stage0026_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
???
「Destroy the false name.
　Destroy it, and cry out... the true name!」

stage0026_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
???
「In that moment, myth will accept you!」

stage0026_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right, I'll cry it out here...!
　The true name!」

stage0026_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This headache...!
　Is it from seeing that robot...!?」

stage0026_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アムロ$$
（What is this...
　Do we already know that thing...?）

stage0026_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That robot... it's just like an angel...」

stage0026_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$n
（But what is it...
　Something inside me is responding to that...）

stage0026_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ドナール$$
「What's going on!
　They destroyed the Guize Stone and merged!?」

stage0026_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$学園長$$
「A, anyway...!
　Transfer a pilot suit to that boy!」

stage0026_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What is this scent...?
　It reeks... unbelievably!」

stage0026_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アマタ$$, what's happening!?
　Are we inside Aquaria!?」

stage0026_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$...!
　Is that really you in there!?」

stage0026_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you know him, $$ミコノ$$?」

stage0026_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Who are you!?
　What do you want, hijacking Aquaria!?」

stage0026_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Hey, you!
　This isn't the time to flirt with your girl!
　You're the one in the head seat!」

stage0026_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'll cover the basic controls from here!
　Fight if you don't want to die!」

stage0026_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right... I have to do this...!
　I have to protect $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0026_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Looks like you're fired up now!
　Give me a little fun, at least!」

stage0026_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（Fufufu... so it's revived, the Mechanical Angel...
　Is this proof the end draws near, too...?）

stage0026_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, cover the machine
　calling itself Aquarion, and intercept
　the Mechanical Beasts and Demon King's army!」

stage0026_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it!
　I don't get it, but I guess we've got no choice!」

stage0026_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$!
　I'll definitely protect you, no matter what!!」

stage0026_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$青山$$
「We were basically saved by the guts
　of that Aquarion thing's pilot.」

stage0026_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$甲児$$
「See that, $$あしゅら$$!
　No matter what trick you pull,
　we're not going to lose!」

stage0026_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「No... perhaps ignorance is happiness.
　Then rot away within that happiness.」

stage0026_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$さやか$$
「$$あしゅら男爵$$, lately...
　keeps saying such ominous things.」

stage0026_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ボス$$
「Guess he's just been polishing up his sore-loser act.」

stage0026_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return to base at once.
　We're pulling back too.」

stage0026_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Contact with those who transferred here
　is best left to the Earth Federation Government.」

stage0026_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$葵$$
「See ya, hot-blooded flying boy.
　Hope we meet again sometime.」

stage0026_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$カイエン$$
「A unit like that, and something opposing it...
　This world doesn't seem peaceful either.」

stage0026_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...We made it...
　We're safe, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0026_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you, $$アマタ$$...
　It's thanks to you trying so hard.」

stage0026_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「A weakling like him, caring about $$ミコノ$$...!」

stage0026_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ドナール$$
「$$カイエン$$, $$ゼシカ$$!
　Bring that kid and the girl back with you!」

stage0026_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Understood, about the boy.
　But, Instructor $$ドナール$$... this woman has no value...」

stage0026_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Someone who barged into Aquaria
　uninvited, I can't just let go that easily!」

stage0026_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Though, for us who transferred
　into this world, there's no home to return to...」

stage0026_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$.
　I'm right here with you.」

stage0026_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I finally found her, at last.
　The one and only person waiting for me...）

stage0026_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
???
「...So you've come too.
　Is this how you all gather...」

stage0026_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
???
「The cycle of death and rebirth...
　Heh... he's probably caught up in it too」

stage0026_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「A beast, and a monster too!」

stage0026_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Hahahahaha!
　I'm not letting you go now!!」

stage0026_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I got it!
　You're there, aren't you!
　The source of that scent... damn woman!」

stage0026_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Wait right there!
　I'll drag you out of there right now,
　and kill you!」

stage0026_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This is your fault, kid!」

stage0026_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「A combination this reckless...!
　And you even dragged $$ミコノ$$ into it...!
　It's all your fault!」

stage0026_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アマタ$$
「When my heart races, I end up floating...」

stage0026_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So that's why you were flying!」

stage0026_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ever since I was a kid, I creeped everyone out...
　I thought that's why she left me behind too...
　So I never meant to use this power again...」

stage0026_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But I... wanted to protect $$ミコノ$$...
　And yet I only got her into something worse...」

stage0026_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Someone like me protecting $$ミコノ$$,
　there was never any way I could...」

stage0026_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Shield level, dropping!
　At this rate, Aquarion will...!」

stage0026_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
???
「To be accepted by myth...
　is to become a myth yourself...
　$$アマタ・ソラ$$... do you have the resolve for that...?」

stage0026_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Calling us both hopeless,
　lumping someone like me in with you...」

stage0026_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アマタ$$, you're amazing.
　We only just met, yet you tried to protect me...
　Me, a whiny little coward...」

stage0026_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you... I'm sorry...
　Thank you...」

stage0026_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s hand is so small,
　so smooth, and so warm...」

stage0026_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$カグラ$$, unfortunately, time's up」

stage0026_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Old man $$イズモ$$, huh!
　I can still fight!」

stage0026_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$イズモ$$
「We need to confirm the $$時空震動$$'s effects.
　Return to base」

stage0026_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$カイエン$$
「To think he beat that monster...」

stage0026_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$シン$$
「What the hell is that robot, Aquarion!?」

stage0026_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Who gives a damn, crazy or not.
　Thanks to it, that monster backed off」

stage0026_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Alright, you!
　Let's keep this up!」

stage0026_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I said I'd do it, but how do I even...!」

stage0026_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Okay?
　I'll teach you how to fight!」

stage0026_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Wh, what is this feeling...!
　It's like I'm being touched right in my body!」

stage0026_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Proof that our auras are in sync.
　Now you can use my power too」

stage0026_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「The enemy's right there!
　Let's go!」

stage0026_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Amazing...!
　That combat power surpasses Aquaria!」

stage0026_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Is the kid in the Head resonating
　with $$ゼシカ$$ and $$カイエン$$...?」

stage0026_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$スオミ$$
「So this is the male-female combination...
　No, this is nothing like Aquaria before...!」

stage0026_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Not bad, you!
　Maybe you've got potential!」

stage0026_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Thank you...!
　It's all thanks to your help!」

stage0026_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Don't let your guard down!
　There's still enemies left!」

stage0026_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$カイエン$$
（Just what in the world is this guy...）

stage0026_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$甲児$$
「Too bad, $$あしゅら男爵$$!
　Even your revived Mechanical Beast ends up like this!」

stage0026_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「For a vessel with no soul, this is the limit...」

stage0026_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But I won't let your sacrifice be wasted」

stage0026_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I smell it... I smell it...!
　I'll sink my teeth into that scent's source!」

stage0026_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't want this! I don't want it!」

stage0026_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What's with this girl!
　All she's done is whine and cry!」

stage0026_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カイエン$$
「We're in combat!
　Get a hold of yourself, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0026_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$ミコノ$$ is a girl...
　Can someone like me protect her...?）

stage0026_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$葵$$
「You look like a ball of wild instinct」

stage0026_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Seems like you're my kind too!」

stage0026_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$くらら$$
「Don't lump us in with a beast, please!」

stage0026_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't act all high and mighty!
　Hurry up and show me you're serious!」

stage0026_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$葵$$
「If that's what you want, I'll show you plenty!
　This is our wild instincts clashing with yours!」

stage0026_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Here I come!
　I'll sink my teeth into your throat!」

stage0026_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$葵$$
「Same goes for us!
　Let's do this!!」

stage0026_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$n
「What's wrong, Miss $$スズネ$$...!?
　You're more assertive than usual...」

stage0026_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I've been leaning on you, $n!
　Even though $n was fighting fear too!」

stage0026_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So I'll get stronger too!
　So I can properly support you, $n!」

stage0026_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Come on, Mechanical Beast!
　If you've been revived, I'll crush you again
　with these two hands!」

stage0026_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$甲児$$
「Watch closely, $$あしゅら$$!
　No matter what trick you try, as long as
　me and Mazinger are around, it's pointless!」

stage0026_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Minions of the Demon King!
　Showing up at a time like this!」

stage0026_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Do it, $$鉄人$$!
　Beat them and stop the Demon King's invasion!」

stage0026_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$タケル$$
（The Demon King behind these guys...
　His presence bears down on me with
　pressure equal to $$ズール$$...）

stage0026_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$タケル$$
（Just who is this Demon King...?
　What is this awful, uneasy feeling...!）

stage0026_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Is someone... watching me...?
　But who could it be...）
